# Fluxguard

Fluxguard is an AI-powered website change detection and monitoring tool that helps businesses track, analyze, and respond to critical changes in web-based data.

Category: Security & Ops. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/fluxguard/.

## Actions

- **Acknowledge Fluxguard Alert**: Acknowledge an alert, marking it as reviewed.
- **Add FluxGuard Page**: Add a new page for monitoring.
- **Create FluxGuard Site Category**: Create a new site category in FluxGuard.
- **Create Webhook**: Create a new webhook for receiving notifications about monitored pages.
- **Delete Fluxguard Page**: Delete a monitored page.
- **Delete Fluxguard Site**: Delete a monitored site.
- **Delete Webhook**: Delete a webhook.
- **Fluxguard Webhook Notification**: Send change data to your webhook endpoint.
- **Get Alert Details** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific alert.
- **Get Changes** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all detected changes across monitored sites.
- **Get FluxGuard Account Data** (read-only): Retrieve general account information for your FluxGuard organization.
- **Get FluxGuard Alerts** (read-only): Retrieve all alerts generated by site changes.
- **Get Fluxguard Change** (read-only): Retrieve details of a change by its ID.
- **Get FluxGuard Site Categories** (read-only): Retrieve all site categories.
- **Get FluxGuard Site Details** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific monitored site by its ID.
- **Get FluxGuard Sites** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all monitored sites.
- **Get FluxGuard User Details** (read-only): Retrieve details that represent the current FluxGuard account as a user-like object.
- **Get FluxGuard Users** (read-only): Retrieve all users in the organization.
- **Get FluxGuard Webhooks** (read-only): Retrieve all configured webhooks.
- **Get Sample Webhook Payload** (read-only): Retrieve a sample webhook payload.
- **Get Site Snapshots** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all site snapshots.
- **Get Snapshot** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific snapshot by its ID.
- **Get Webhook Details** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific webhook by its ID.
